EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KALUTARA URBAN COUNCILUNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Kalutara Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

And whereas the Secretary of the People’s Liberation Front, the recognized political party to which KurukulasooriyaPatabandiarachchiralalage Laxman Henry Silva the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of theaforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned member if People’s Liberation Front who belongs to such party and is notdisqualified under Section 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a memberwithin a period of thirty (30) days ;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision to nominateSamarasinghe Hewage Danuj Niroshan Somarathna to fill such vacancy ;

Now therefore I, Hannedige Rasika Priyanga Peiris, Returning Officer of the Kalutara Urban Council, acting interms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that SamarasingheHewage Danuj Niroshan Somarathna was elected as the member of the Kalutara Urban Council.
